headlines.summary: 今日上午，一份疑似券商内部风控通知在资本市场流传，针对即将登陆科创板的长鑫科技，要求分支机构防范新股炒作，引发市场广泛关注。网传通知显示，该券商要求各分公司、各营业部通过有效方式提示50万元以上客户避免参与长鑫科技上市初期炒作，理性合规交易；重点关注惯于炒新追热点、多次触发合规预警的客户，对交易所重点监控账户进行电话警示，严防异常交易行为。

headlines.title_en: Rumored Brokerage Internal Notice on Changxin Technology IPO Speculation; Multiple Branch Sources Deny Receiving Similar Notice
headlines.summary_en: This morning, a suspected internal risk control notice from a brokerage circulated in capital markets, regarding ChangXin Memory Technologies about to list on STAR Market, requiring branches to prevent new stock speculation, sparking widespread market attention. The circulated notice said the brokerage requires all branches and business outlets to effectively remind clients with over 500,000 yuan to avoid participating in initial stage speculation of ChangXin Memory Technologies, and trade rationally and compliantly; focus on clients accustomed to chasing new stocks and hot themes who have triggered compliance warnings multiple times, issue phone warnings to accounts under exchange key monitoring, and strictly prevent abnormal trading behavior.

headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...

headlines.title: 国务院成立广西南宁横州市六蓝水库“7·6”溃坝灾害调查评估组
headlines.summary: 7月6日，广西南宁横州市六蓝水库发生溃坝，造成重大人员伤亡。根据国家有关法律法规规定，国务院成立调查评估组，由应急管理部牵头，自然资源部、住房城乡建设部、水利部、农业农村部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部、公安部、财政部、交通运输部、中国气象局、国家能源局、国家消防救援局和广西壮族自治区人民政府等相关方面参加，对广西南宁横州市六蓝水库“7·6”溃坝灾害进行调查评估。7月24日，国务院广西南宁横州市六蓝水库“7·6”溃坝灾害调查评估组在广西南宁召开第一次全体会议。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: State Council Establishes Investigation and Assessment Team for ‘July 6’ Dam Failure at Liulan Reservoir in Hengzhou, Guangxi
headlines.summary_en: On July 6, the Liulan Reservoir in Hengzhou, Nanning, Guangxi suffered a dam breach, causing heavy casualties. According to relevant national laws and regulations, the State Council established an investigation and assessment team, led by the Ministry of Emergency Management, with participation from the Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Transport, China Meteorological Administration, National Energy Administration, National Fire and Rescue Service, and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region People's Government, to investigate and assess the '7·6' dam breach disaster at Liulan Reservoir in Hengzhou, Nanning, Guangxi. On July 24, the State Council investigation and assessment team for the '7·6' Liulan Reservoir dam breach disaster in Hengzhou, Nanning, Guangxi held its first plenary meeting in Nanning, Guangxi. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 英国6月零售销售强劲增长，再次超出预期

headlines.title_en: UK June Retail Sales Strongly Rebound, Again Exceeding Expectations
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 24 - UK National Statistics Office data Friday showed UK June retail sales unexpectedly rose 1.0% month-on-month, while economists had forecast a 0.3% decline. June retail sales rose 4.2% year-on-year, also above the 2.3% increase economists expected. UK National Statistics Office senior statistician Hannah Finselbach said demand for 'outdoor goods, air conditioning, and clothing' was strong in June, and online sales of sporting goods were also strong. These data provide further evidence that consumer sentiment is improving after Middle East conflict hit consumer confidence. With fuel and food prices falling, household inflation fell to its lowest level in over a year, and the labor market downturn also showed signs of stabilizing. However, the recovery remains fragile. The recent collapse of the US-Iran ceasefire agreement has again raised concerns

headlines.title_en: Research Report Pick: Huayuan Securities Initiates ‘Buy’ Rating on Foran Energy, Sees Green Methanol and SOFC Unlocking Growth Potential
headlines.summary_en: Huayuan Securities research report points out that Foran Energy Group has stable cash flow, and green methanol and SOFC are expected to open up growth space. The company has been deeply involved in city gas business for over 30 years, holding 13 regional pipeline gas business franchises. The company's main businesses include city gas, supply chain, new energy, extension, and R&D and equipment manufacturing businesses, with 2025 gross profit shares of 77.0%, 6.6%, 7.0%, 9.1%, and 0.4% respectively; city gas main business contributes core profit, while supply chain business revenue grows rapidly. City gas demand is stable, gas sources diverse, building a stable profit base. Expanding diversified energy layout, green methanol and SOFC businesses are expected to open growth space. Selecting ENN Energy, Shenzhen Gas, and Jiufeng Energy as comparable companies, the company's city gas main business operates stably, green methanol and SOFC businesses are expected to open growth space.
